title: Multiplex Routing
brief: Clean system architecture diagram, cream background. Left: three inbound arrows labeled Telegram bot token / Discord bot token / /p/<profile>/ URL 前缀, converging into a routing box titled 'profile_routes 路由表（按 user / guild / chat / thread 匹配）'. Center: one large box '单一网关进程（multiplexer）' containing a vertical stack of per-turn scope items: 凭据（auth.json + .env）/ 模型 / 技能 / 记忆 / SOUL / 终端设置 / 命令白名单 / 代理 / 日志; two highlighted callouts beside the stack: 'ContextVar home 覆盖（set_hermes_home_override，不用 os.environ）' and '会话命名空间 agent:<profile>:*'. Right: three profile folders side by side, each with its own state.db badge, labeled profiles/coder/ · profiles/research/ · profiles/personal/. A small red badge top-right: '同名 bot token → 重复适配器 park（fatal / duplicate_credential）'. Bottom band across: '共享的只有：进程、PID / lock、一个 HTTP listener、profile_routes 表'. Flat vector infographic style, thin connectors, terracotta orange and ink blue accents, bilingual Chinese/English labels, tidy and precise.
